summary: Tencent Music Entertainment Group (TME) files a Form 6-K announcing the completion of its acquisition of Ximalaya Inc. The merger consideration consists of up to $1.26 billion in cash and up to 175,288,891 TME Class A ordinary shares (a mix of newly issued shares and shares underlying equity awards). The deal was previously disclosed on June 10, 2025, and closed on May 18, 2026, making Ximalaya a wholly-owned subsidiary. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee is stated. The transaction is structured as a merger with cancellation of Ximalaya equity. What to watch: integration execution and potential dilution from the share component.
